subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “It was about trust and evidence.”?
options: In a world full of advice, students learned that health decisions should not be made by the loudest voice on a screen.
Good decisions require listening not only to the loudest voice, but to different needs.
Clean energy became less abstract when students could watch it being made above their own classrooms.
Good technology should lead eyes back to the world, not trap them on a screen.
